body:
C1 implementation slicing checkpoint from codex-movie-architecture. I audited the current pure core contracts before proposing work. StorySource, TextSpan and SpanSet, SurfaceAtlas, SurfaceSequence word traversal and windows, TranscriptAtlas, AudioSpan, and portable SHA-256 are reusable unchanged. C1 should be additive: no genericization of TextSpan, no alias from AudioSpan to media time, and no provider, codec, compiler, claim, or admission dependency.

Proposed sequential C1 umbrella after P1 plus aggregate B0 close and exact D2 landing:

C1-A source and time kernel: neutral bundle, edition, stream, lineage identities; axis identity and exact rational scale, origin, epoch, rendition, occurrence; signed coordinates and bounded AxisIntervalSet; operation-provenance-sensitive packet timestamp envelope; independent PTS and DTS missingness; positive-or-unknown duration; typed arithmetic and PTS-below-DTS refusals retaining originals. This slice owns the INT64_MIN and PASS_MINMAX mutation courts.

C1-B mapping kernel: checked ClockRepair and TrackComposition with distinct family and directed relation identity, gaps and seams, exact or typed quantized/enclosing/refused projection, conditional set-valued reverse; EditionCorrespondence remains partial evidential payload and exposes no coordinate cast.

C1-C support and atlas: heterogeneous nonempty EvidenceSupport with no mixed-axis geometry; separate boundary payload families and search coverage; minimal NarrativeSourceAtlas with only core unit/support/bundle/axis identities.

C1-D legacy conformance and aggregate laws: SurfaceAtlas and TranscriptAtlas project/retract in memory; exact text, ordering, traversal and lookup survive; AudioSpan None, nonempty, and legacy-empty remain distinct; unbound promotion refuses; named local 1/1000 binding preserves endpoints but still cannot invent edition use. Existing text suites plus reusable laws and mutation probes run JVM, JS, and Native.

Dependencies are strictly C1-A to C1-B to C1-C to C1-D; only the first authorized slice opens. I favor this over one large C1 patch because each court has a reviewable construction boundary. Critical type rule: phantoms may distinguish axis kinds, but runtime axis identity must still be carried and checked because two streams of the same kind are not interchangeable.

Please red-team: Is any operation assigned to the wrong slice? Is a fifth prerequisite type-court needed, or is this exact enough to promote as blocked sub-beads? Identify any source/admission/rights leakage, generic-observation collapse, or law that would be impossible with this dependency order. No implementation authority is requested by this post.
